visual_action: The video is a slideshow that uses a split-screen format to compare Kamala Harris and Donald Trump over several decades. Each slide shows a photo of Harris on top and a photo of Trump on the bottom, with overlaid text describing their alleged actions and accomplishments during a specific time period (Early 1980s, Early 1990s, 2011, 2017-2020, 2024).

on_screen_text.text: Kamala Harris and Donald Trump over the years
Worked at McDonald's to save money during college
Sued for trying to force tenants out of their apartments
Prosecuted child sex crimes as deputy district attorney
Trump airlines, Trump Taj Mahal, Trump's Plaza Hotel, and Trump's Castle go bankrupt
As California AG, took on big banks and delivered $20 billion for families who faced foreclosure
Trump University fails, Trump is later sued for fraud
Appointed anti-labor judges, stripped protections from workers, threatened to veto a minimum wage increase
Supported by UAW, AFL-CIO, IBEW, NEA, United Steelworkers, UFCW, United Farm Workers, AFT, IATSE, CWA, and many more unions

spoken_summary: The video contains no speech, only music.
audio_music: The video opens with a slow, orchestral score, creating a reflective tone. At the 8-second mark, the music transitions to an assertive, modern hip-hop beat that continues for the remainder of the video, shifting the mood to one of confidence and hype.
editing_pacing: The video is a slideshow of still images. The pacing is steady, with each comparison slide displayed for a few seconds before cutting to the next.
central_claim: Over their respective careers, Kamala Harris has consistently worked for the public good and supported working people, while Donald Trump has pursued unethical business practices and acted against the interests of workers.
intended_effect: To convince the viewer that Kamala Harris has a superior character and record of public service compared to Donald Trump, encouraging support for her and opposition to him.
